content:
watchOS 27 is the latest major software update for Apple Watch, bringing three brand-new apps to your smartwatch.

#1: Siri

Siri has received a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, including an all-new Siri app.

The Siri app is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

You can still summon Siri with the Digital Crown in watchOS 27, but the app provides another way to start a conversation. More importantly, you can browse through your past conversation history directly within the app.

Siri AI feels more conversational than its predecessor, and it syncs your queries across all your devices. So the Siri app on watchOS 27 doesn't just show Apple Watch conversations, but also records from your iPhone, Mac, and other devices.

#2: Find My

In addition to the new features in the Find My app on iOS 27, Apple has also redesigned the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My was split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple has brought all Find My functionality back together into a single, unified, brand-new Find My app.

The Find My app on Apple Watch offers all the features of the previous three apps, but in a more unified experience—you can easily find any item or person through a map-centric interface.

You can switch between different search categories via the menu in the top-left corner, and beyond that, the operational experience remains consistent.

#3: Readiness

If you have an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 also adds a third app: Readiness.

Here's the App Store description of the Readiness app's features:

The Readiness app analyzes your recent activity, vital signs, and sleep data to help you understand how prepared you are to take on a new day. Features include: getting a score and clear status category, including "Recovering," "Take It Easy," "Ready," or "Go All In." View explanations of the various contributing factors, with the option to tap through to the relevant app. New watch face complications and smart stack widgets give you an at-a-glance overview. View more detailed information in the Fitness app on iPhone.

In short, Readiness gives you a quick overall snapshot of your vital signs, so you can understand how well-rested and prepared your body is on any given day.

What are your thoughts on the new Apple Watch apps in watchOS 27? Share them with us in the comments.
